Better than Black Friday • Deal #4
4 PJ-soft palazzo pants for $99
Add any 4 pairs to your bag and the price drops from $256 to $99. That's $24.75 a pair, you save $157. Real pockets in every pair. No code needed.
+ Mix sizes: 02-12, 08-20 and 14-32 all count toward your 4.
+ Fit tip: they run on the shorter side, so at 5'8" or taller expect an ankle-length fit.
+ Pick your colors: tell us what you love in your order notes and we'll do our best to hand-pick yours.
+ Four gifts, one checkout: add 8 and it's $198, a $314 savings.
Through Thursday 11/12, or until sizes sell out.

The Free Spirit Wide-Leg Palazzo Pants are made from hand-coordinated, upcycled Indian sari silk — so no two pairs are ever the same. Every single one arrives as a little work of art. And now? Every single one has pockets.

These are the pants your friends will ask about. The ones you'll wear to the farmers market, the library, the yoga studio, and somehow also to that thing you had to look put-together for. They just work.

✨ What makes them special:

♻️ Truly one of a kind — Upcycled sari silk means your pair exists nowhere else on earth. Leave a color preference in the notes at checkout and we'll handpick something you'll love.

🧘♀️ The waistband that fits every body — Super stretchy, wear it high-waisted or folded over. Sizes 00–32, designed to fit heights from 5'2" to 5'10". Want a looser fit? Size up.

👖 Yes, pockets — Real ones. Every pair.

🌬️ Impossibly soft and flowy — The fabric moves with you. Break dance in them (yes, a real customer did this). Lounge in them. Live in them.

🎨 Tell us your colors — Leave a note at checkout with your color preferences and we'll hand-select your pair.

🌱 Good for the planet, good for people — Made from upcycled materials in fair trade co-ops in India, supporting 600+ artisans worldwide.

🧺 Easy care — Machine wash in a mesh bag, tumble dry low, remove promptly. Done.

"You can really move in these. You can even break dance like an Olympic Athlete. Light, soft, easy to pack, and so pretty. I think I need two more pairs." — Julie G.M. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

"Oh my gosh! I love these! Definitely plan to order more!" — Sandra J. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

"Every time I wear them I get 'oohs' and 'ahhs' and compliments galore." — Valerie ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
